name: Fire and electricity on moves Shadow already has
description: A REBUILD OF THE LAST TWO QUESTIONS ONTO MOVES THE LEVEL 19 SAVE CAN ACTUALLY CAST. The focus_field_minimal probe put fire on Blue Bomber and electricity on Fastball, both Sonic's, and on that save Sonic does not have the POW points to unlock either - so those two thirds of the build were uncastable. Shadow has 25 unspent points and, per the POW panel, Chaos Spear and Chaos Rift already bought to tier III. This moves the same two questions onto those two moves. IT IS ALSO A STRICTLY CLEANER EXPERIMENT, which is the part worth noticing. Blue Bomber and Fastball are 2-participant moves, so testing them meant converting them to solo as well, and every reading would have carried two edits. Chaos Spear and Chaos Rift are ALREADY solo in vanilla - participants 1, partners -1, -1, -1 - so this build changes the element column and nothing else whatsoever. One variable, which is what evidence standard 5 asks for and what the earlier shape could not give. Chaos Spear is the better of the two: elementless AND statusless in vanilla, like Axe Kick, so it is a clean subject. Chaos Rift carries Distracted, which makes it a second instance of the element-onto-a-move-that-already-has-a-status shape that Axe Kick plus ice plus Vulnerable already cleared. WHAT THIS BUYS, STATED HONESTLY. The question that justified this investigation - is adding an element to an elementless move unsafe? - is ANSWERED, by Focus Field itself working in isolation on 2026-10-12, and the refusal has already been dropped to a warning on that basis. This build does not change that decision. It buys two things and they are both modest: the element table closes at six of six confirmed in play rather than four, and the sample of moves known to tolerate an add goes from three to five. Per evidence standard 7 that is firming up a conclusion already reached, not opening a new question, and it is offered because the moves are already unlocked and the save is already in hand, not because the answer is needed. tier_text is written in the GAME'S OWN IDIOM this time. The focus_field_minimal build used prose and the POW panel clipped it mid-sentence - the Effect line is one line, no wrapping, and vanilla never exceeds 45 characters. Vanilla writes 'Element: Fire' and 'Can't miss, Element: Electricity'; these match that. force_element is no longer required, and is deliberately omitted so that the new warning gets exercised on a real build.
